Miniature Ball Bearings

Bearings with an outer diameter under 9mm are generally classified as miniature bearings, while those with an outer diameter of 9mm or more and a bore under 10mm are classified as extra-small bearings.

Available in Open Type · Flanged Type · Sealed Type.

You can search by entering just part of the model number or dimensions.
